
---
title: "Movie Analysis"
author: "Madison Goin"
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| message: false

library(tidyverse)

movies <- read_csv("data/movies.csv")
```

```{r}
#| cache: true

movies_clean <- movies |>
  separate_rows(genre, sep = ", ")
```

```{r}
movies |>
  ggplot(aes(x = tomatoMeter)) +
  geom_histogram() +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Tomatometer Scores",
    subtitle = paste("Number of films:", sum(!is.na(movies$tomatoMeter))),
    x = "Tomatometer Score",
    y = "Count"
  )
```

```{r}
movies_gap <- movies_clean |>
  filter(tomatoMeter != 0, audienceScore != 0) |>
  mutate(gap = tomatoMeter - audienceScore)

movies_summary <- movies_gap |>
  group_by(genre) |>
  summarise(
    mean_gap = mean(gap, na.rm = TRUE),
    film_count = n()
  ) |>
  filter(film_count >= 100) |>
  arrange(mean_gap)
```

```{r}
movies_summary |>
  ggplot(aes(x = mean_gap, y = fct_reorder(genre, mean_gap, .desc = TRUE))) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0) +
  labs(
    title = "Average Critic-Audience Score Gap by Genre",
    subtitle = "Negative gaps favor audiences; positive gaps favor critics",
    x = "Average Tomatometer Score minus Audience Score",
    y = "Genre"
  )
```

```{r}
spiderman <- movies |>
  filter(title %in% c(
    "Spider-Man",
    "Spider-Man 2",
    "Spider-Man 3",
    "The Amazing Spider-Man",
    "The Amazing Spider-Man 2",
    "Spider-Man: Homecoming",
    "Spider-Man: Far From Home",
    "Spider-Man: No Way Home"
  )) |>
  arrange(releaseDateTheaters)

spiderman |>
  select(title, releaseDateTheaters, tomatoMeter, audienceScore) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(tomatoMeter, audienceScore),
    names_to = "score_type",
    values_to = "score"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    title = factor(title, levels = unique(title)),
    score_type = recode(
      score_type,
      tomatoMeter = "Tomatometer",
      audienceScore = "Audience Score"
    )
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = title, y = score, color = score_type, group = score_type)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  labs(
    title = "Audiences Favored Four of the Five Films After Spider-Man 3",
    x = "Film (in release order)",
    y = "Score",
    color = "Score type"
  ) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```
